prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1271; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the rear-end collision described in your file. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this claim to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please confirm receipt of this request in writing.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, vehicle inspection reports, repair estimates, recorded statements, telematics or event data recorder information, claim notes, and any surveillance or third-party material in your possession. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in sanctions in any subsequent litigation.

We look forward to your prompt response so that we can begin evaluating this claim.
